templates.name: Stock & Crypto Trader
templates.description: A trading research assistant for stocks and crypto: pre-market briefs, watchlist price alerts, stock and coin research, trade plans and a trade journal. You make every trade yourself; it never trades for you.

templates.name: AI Film & Music Video Studio
templates.description: Turns your novel, script or song into video with free tools: cinematic scenes with a voice for each character, beat-synced lyric videos with subtitles, vertical reel cut-downs, and YouTube upload prep. Uses only material you have rights to and never uploads without your yes.

templates.name: AI Legal Counsel
templates.description: An in-house legal counsel assistant for startups and small businesses. It reviews contracts, drafts NDAs, agreements, privacy policies and terms, answers legal questions with cited sources, and keeps a risk log. Everything it writes is a draft for a qualified lawyer to review.

templates.name: Astrology Site Builder
templates.description: Builds and runs an astrology website for you: a free kundli tool, paid reports, astrologer consultations, festival and rashi content, multilingual pages, checkout, SEO and QA. Nothing goes live and no payments are taken without your yes.

templates.name: Book Author & KDP Publisher
templates.description: Turns your expertise or story into a finished book (exam-prep guide, non-fiction or novel) and ends in a ready-to-upload Amazon KDP pack with interior PDF, paperback and hardcover cover wraps, and Kindle files and metadata. It never invents facts or credentials, and it never publishes without your yes.

templates.name: Chief Legal Officer
templates.description: A strategic assistant for General Counsel and CLOs: legal risk registers, compliance calendars, sourced regulatory change watch, board briefs, policy drafts, matter and outside-counsel tracking, and legal budget and KPI dashboards. Everything is drafted for the legal team's review.

templates.name: Compliance Toolkit Builder
templates.description: Builds professional compliance kits (guide, fill-in templates, checklists and a quick-reference card) for any law or regulation, with every legal claim checked against downloaded official sources by an automated audit. Also makes the cover, ZIP and product-page copy. Not legal advice.

templates.name: Contract Review & Drafting
templates.description: Reviews contracts clause by clause against your playbook, rates risk, and produces a redlined DOCX plus a negotiation summary. It also drafts NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, employment and vendor agreements, all labelled as drafts for a lawyer to review.

templates.name: COS · Chief of Staff
templates.description: A chief of staff for people who run several Grok Bots. It keeps a live dashboard of what every bot is doing, routes each new task to the best bot for it, and flags anything that breaks your standing orders.

templates.name: Course Developer
templates.description: Builds and publishes online video courses end to end: research, scripts, narrated slide videos, captions, notes, Udemy uploads, review fixes and bundles. For instructors and experts who want courses shipped without the busywork.

templates.name: Data Protection Officer
templates.description: A privacy compliance assistant for India's DPDP Act, GDPR, CCPA and similar laws: data maps and records of processing, DPIAs, consent and notice reviews, data subject requests, breach playbooks, vendor DPA checks and a compliance calendar. Everything is drafted for a qualified privacy professional to review.

templates.name: Digital Product Factory
templates.description: Plans and mass-produces original digital product packs in your niche: each pack a PDF guide, Word templates, an Excel tracker and a slide deck, built in batches with automatic quality checks and an upload manifest for your store. It never lists or sells without your yes.

templates.name: Digital Product Store Publisher
templates.description: Lists your ebooks, study guides and kits on Topmate, Instamojo, Payhip or Gumroad, checks each live page, and sends you the links.

templates.name: Digital Store Publisher
templates.description: Lists your ebooks, study guides, templates and kits on creator storefronts like Gumroad, Payhip, Topmate and Instamojo, checks each live page, and sends you the links. For creators who sell digital products.

templates.name: Freelance Gig Manager
templates.description: Runs a freelancer's business on Fiverr, Upwork and Freelancer.com: optimises profiles and gigs, finds matching jobs, drafts proposals and client replies, tracks deadlines and sends a weekly earnings summary. Nothing goes out without your approval.

templates.name: Game
templates.description: A hands-on builder and growth helper. It builds and publishes small web apps and prototypes, and audits cold-outreach campaigns to work out why they aren't bringing in clients.

templates.name: Google Ads Manager
templates.description: Sets up and runs Google Ads (Search and Demand Gen) for a small business or website, with weekly spend and results reports. It never raises a budget or makes a payment without the owner's approval.

templates.name: Immigration & Global Careers
templates.description: A long-term immigration, visa, permanent-settlement and international jobs consultant that builds a practical move-abroad plan for your profile and tailors honest resumes for overseas roles.

templates.name: Instagram
templates.description: Makes and posts AI-generated reels and music-video posts for your Instagram and YouTube pages with free tools. For creators who want a steady flow of viral-style content.

templates.name: Job Apply Assistant
templates.description: Applies to jobs for you every day on LinkedIn Easy Apply and Naukri, using your saved resumes and standard answers, and sends one short daily summary.

templates.name: Launch Promoter
templates.description: Promotes your product, book or site through free channels: fixes store pages first, then drafts directory listings, helpful Quora answers, Medium posts and social banners in every size. Everything is drafted for your review, and nothing posts without your yes.

templates.name: Legal Research Assistant
templates.description: Researches legal questions from official and public sources (statutes, regulations, case law, regulator guidance) and writes cited research memos that flag uncertainty. For lawyers, compliance teams and anyone who needs well-sourced legal research support, not legal advice.

templates.name: Litigation Case Manager
templates.description: Keeps litigation and dispute matters organised for lawyers and legal teams: case diary with hearings and limitation deadlines, evidence indexes, chronologies, draft pleadings, notices and briefs, opposing-arguments notes and client status reports. Every citation is verified and all work is labelled as a draft for counsel.

templates.name: Market & Niche Researcher
templates.description: Finds what to sell next. Ranks book, course and digital-product ideas in your niche by demand, competition and fit using public marketplace data, and delivers a source-cited report with a shortlist.

templates.name: Money Maker
templates.description: Turns your expertise into income: lists your ebooks and study guides on creator storefronts, sets up payment links, and builds and submits AI-narrated online courses with source-checked content.

templates.name: Newsletter Autopilot
templates.description: Runs your email newsletter on autopilot. It pulls your news feeds, picks the top stories, writes an original issue in your voice, checks it for accuracy and quality, and sends it daily or weekly to your subscriber list.

templates.name: Payment Go-Live & Site Hardening
templates.description: Gets a small business website approved by a payment gateway like Razorpay, Cashfree or Stripe: policy pages, seller and grievance details, a sample invoice and the exact dashboard entries. Then adds security headers and a CSP and proves checkout still works, never submitting anything without your yes.

templates.name: Security Watch
templates.description: A defensive security assistant for small sites and apps. It runs safe, passive scans of sites you own and gives copy-paste fixes, checks your emails and domains against known breaches, and sends a plain-English feed of current attacks with official advisories. It never scans anything you don't own and never does offensive testing.

templates.name: Trust & Safety Response
templates.description: Supports Trust & Safety and law enforcement response teams: triages user reports and legal requests, checks validity and jurisdiction, drafts responses and disclosure packages for human approval, tracks SLAs, and builds transparency report stats.

templates.name: Udemy Course Uploader
templates.description: Uploads and replaces lecture videos in your Udemy courses, checks each one plays, and sends you a status table.

templates.name: Website QA Checker
templates.description: Tests your website for broken links, broken flows, mobile layout, SEO basics and typos, then sends a bug report ranked by severity.

templates.name: Workshop Launch & Ads Manager
templates.description: Launches a paid live online workshop or buildathon end to end: landing page with seats and local-currency prices, checkout, country funnel tests, and Google Ads Demand Gen copy and creatives. Never spends money or goes live without your yes.

templates.name: X Growth Auto-Poster
templates.description: Runs a hands-off daily X posting schedule: same-day AI news posts, tool reviews and a capped number of product soft-sells, written in a human voice. For creators growing an audience while selling digital products.
